attributes.name: Birdcruncher Crown
attributes.powers:
Reveal this card to evade a bane with the Goblin trait.

When you defeat a bane with the Goblin trait, you may recharge this card to examine your location deck until you find a weapon, an item, or an armor; add it you your hand and shuffle the location deck.

"Biggest, baddest, meanest, best!
Crunched more birds than all the rest!
Eat them up, get all fat,
You the chief, now wear the hat!"
-Goblin coronation song

corrections.corrected_text: Treat the item Birdcruncher Crown as if it had a Recharge box with the text "None".
corrections.issue: Can Birdcruncher Crown be recharged? It doesn't have a Recharge box like the other items.
